integrity: All universal mathematical statements are supported analytically; the supplementary checker is finite evidence only. Literature-bounded originality assessment and no independent scientific audit.
scientific_limitations: Two agents, symmetric positive baseline, integer delay and strictly interior histories; for feedback exceeding baseline only linear instability for sufficiently large delays, not an oscillation theorem. Source extension allows negative favorability parameters while normalized weights remain positive.
title: Sharp delay-robust equalization and delayed instability in a two-agent influence model
